description: This Java abstract class defines a node in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) that can have child nodes. It supports managing child nodes, accepting visitors, and overrides standard Object methods like toString, hashCode, and equals.

classes.name: SuperNode
classes.description: An abstract class representing a node in an AST with child nodes. It provides methods for managing children, accepting visitors, and standard object method overrides.

methods.name: SuperNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an empty list of children.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the list of child nodes.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor to perform operations on this node.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including its children.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the children.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this node and another object based on children.
